source.title: Default mode network coherence in treatment-resistant major depressive disorder during electroconvulsive therapy.

confidence_rationale: In treatment-resistant MDD, decreased DMN network coherence (precuneus, angular gyrus) NORMALISED in ECT responders but PERSISTED in non-responders. Direct evidence that the depressive network regime is reconfigurable when a sufficiently strong repair intervention succeeds, and stays locked when it fails -- i.e. reversibility is conditional on repair success rather than absolute. Confidence held to moderate by the small sample (8 responders, 8 non-responders).
failure_signatures: DMN coherence did not normalise in ECT non-responders, demonstrating that even the strongest available somatic repair route fails to reconfigure the regime in a subset of (already treatment-resistant) patients.

mapping.source_claim_statement: In treatment-resistant MDD, DMN network coherence is reduced relative to controls and normalises after ECT in clinical responders but not in non-responders.
mapping.ree_translation: Supports conditional reversibility of MECH-367's regime: when REE's repair machinery (here the biological analogue is ECT-driven reconfiguration) succeeds, the network regime returns toward baseline; when it fails, the regime persists. Argues against a hard chronicity-lock for the responder subgroup while showing genuine resistance in non-responders.
mapping.mapping_caveat: ECT is a brute-force perturbation with no clean REE analogue among the listed repair routes (offline integration, decommitment, social re-access, goal re-coupling); responder/non-responder status is defined by symptoms, not by illness duration, so this does not isolate the RA-001 duration variable. Very small N.
mapping.source_context: Human resting-state fMRI; 16 treatment-resistant MDD (8 responders / 8 non-responders) pre/post ECT vs 16 matched controls; novel within-network coherence metric.

confidence_components.notes: Good design and a directly relevant responder/non-responder contrast, but n=8 per cell caps source quality and the authors themselves flag the result as tentative.
